lblExplainTarget: What to do in this window, and what the list holds while it is being read.
lblF: The position selected or tapped, in the theater's feet (north and east).
lblCurCoordinates: The position selected or tapped, in latitude and longitude.
btnCancel: Closes the window and changes nothing.
btnApply: Uses the selection. DataCard: the objective, the building (the DMPI, your aim point) and its position with the ground's height go into the TGT boxes. DTC page: the target or steerpoint is set.
dgvObjectives: The places to pick from, with position, elevation in feet and who holds them. Tap one to select it: the map shows it, and on the DataCard its buildings are listed under the map.
cboObjectives: Which places the list shows: one type, or All. On the DataCard you can also type part of a name to find every objective holding it.
chbFill: Draws the marks on the map filled in rather than as outlines.
chbNr: Writes each mark's name beside it on the map.
chbShowAll: On the DataCard: lists and draws the buildings worth nothing too. On the DTC page: lists every place in view on the map.
dgvFed: On the DataCard: the selected objective's buildings, where each is, the ground's height and its worth; tap one to aim at it, a double tap applies it. On the DTC page: the selection.
lblFeet: The position selected or tapped, in the theater's feet (north and east).
lblCurCoord: The position selected or tapped, in latitude and longitude.
cntImageControl: The ground around the selection, from the app's theater map. A tap picks the nearest mark (the one picked is red) and reads out the position tapped.
chbTiles: Draws the app's theater map under the marks. Needs the theater Falcon BMS is on.
